steps.speaker: Diego
steps.content: We... won?

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Didn't expect that, did you! The big boss of the Gonzales family getting captured by DeadLover Radio!

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: Tell your people not to mess with us again, or else...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Or else, we'll let everyone in Syndicate know that you got caught by us! Your family will lose its reputation forever!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Love is so awesome! Wait, no. This kind of monologue sounds too much like a villain.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: And shouldn't we be helping Diego realize his filmmaking dream?

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Then how should it be done?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The plot should go like this...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Seeing his aging father admit defeat for the first time, Diego also feels very sad.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: He tenderly explains his dream to his father, and the efforts he had made over the years to make it come true.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Now, he has finally met like-minded companions. He must seize this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, for the DisCars are within reach!

steps.speaker: Young Diego
steps.content: "Father, I wish you can be proud of me, even if it's just once..."

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: In the face of his son's sincerity, the baddy daddy falls silent.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Though he's a baddy daddy, he still loves his son. He just doesn't want him to get hurt. But he realizes that his son is a big boy now. It's time to let go.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: He turns to leave, but stops by the door.

steps.speaker: Baddy Francisco
steps.content: "Go do what you want. I won't stop you anymore. Just... If things get too tough, you can always come home."

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Sob, how touching!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Right? You think so, too, don't you, Love?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hey old man, be more open-minded. Quit trying to stop Diego from pursuing his dreams.

steps.speaker: Francisco
steps.content: What the hell are you talking about? Kill or maim me if you want, but don't ******* disgust me with this nonsense!

steps.speaker: Francisco
steps.content: He sits at home and does nothing but listens to your ******* radio show. After a while, he doesn't even stay at home anymore. He goes to squat in front of your door all day.

steps.speaker: Francisco
steps.content: This little bastard really has issues. I just want to get him home so he doesn't embarrass me outside.

steps.speaker: Francisco
steps.content: Keep him if you want. I won't stick around anymore. But I'll definitely get my revenge for what happened today! Just you wait!

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Before everyone's stunned gazes, Francisco breaks free from the rope around his body and flees.

steps.speaker: Diego
steps.content: I... I can explain...

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: No need...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Disgusting.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Hey, don't be so judgmental. It's normal for a radio show as popular as ours to have a few crazy fans.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: But since you love our show so much, why don't you... work for us?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: You know, because of your dad, several dozen of our staff all fled.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: From now on, you can cover all their shifts!
